name: Web only landing
evidence: One H1, three source services, no manifest or application download UI.

name: Responsive layout
evidence: No horizontal overflow or broken images at 320, 375, 390, 768, 1024, and 1440 px.

name: Mobile menu
evidence: Opens, closes with Escape, restores focus, closes after section navigation.

name: Anchor links
evidence: Every visible hero, header, section, skip, footer, pickup, and top link targets an existing section.

name: Service CTAs
evidence: Each service selects the matching form option and focuses the service field.

name: Order validation and pricing
evidence: Empty form and missing pickup address prevent submission; 2.5 kg=Rp15.000, 2 items=Rp36.000, fractional item invalid. Complete form shows request summary and temporary number notice.

name: WhatsApp handoff and copy
evidence: Correct normalized temporary number, encoded details, clipboard success, and stale summary invalidation. External WA requests intercepted; no message sent.

name: FAQ
evidence: All six accordions open and close.

name: Contact and review links
evidence: 5 visible floating, help, review, contact and footer WhatsApp links open the configured contact.

name: Accessibility
evidence: Axe WCAG A/AA scan: no violations on public desktop page.

name: Keyboard skip
evidence: Tab focuses visible skip link; Enter navigates to main.

name: Login page
evidence: Staff link opens existing login, signup/login tabs work, password visibility toggle works, back link returns to storefront.

name: Protected routes
evidence: All nine operational routes still require authentication.

name: Removed installation route
evidence: Removed path shows real 404 with working return link.

name: Browser runtime
evidence: No page exceptions or console errors during the tested flow.
